en: And she said , Behold , thy sister in law is gone back unto her people , and unto her gods :  return thou after thy sister in law .

en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab , over against Beth–peor :  but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day .

en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .
as: দিয়া জনৰ বাবে ভেঁটি যাদুৰ পাথৰৰ দৰে ; যি ফালেই তেওঁ যায় , সেই ফালেই তেওঁ সফল হয় ।

en: The Levites :  the children of Jeshua , of Kadmiel , and of the children of Hodevah , seventy and four .

en: For I am with thee , and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee for I have much people in this city .

en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north , he measured the length thereof , and the breadth thereof .

en: Full of or showing high spirited merriment .

en: ( Job 2 : 3 ) Governments may ban , imprison , and mistreat God’s servants and may label them “ persona non grata . ”

en: To prevent ‘ distress from rising up a second time ,’ Jehovah will annihilate Satan , his demons , and all who rebel against Jehovah’s sovereignty .
as: ‘দ্বিতীয় বাৰৰ বাবে দুৰ্দশা উৎপন্ন’ হোৱাপৰা বাধা দিবলৈ চয়তান , তাৰ পিশাচবোৰ আৰু লগতে যিহোৱাৰ আধিপত্যৰ বিৰোদ্ধে বিদ্ৰোহ কৰা সকলো মানুহক যিহোৱাই সম্পূৰ্ণৰূপে চিৰকালৰ বাবে ধ্বংস কৰিব ।

en: And it came to pass , as he sat at the table with them , he took bread , and blessed it , and brake , and gave to them .

en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly :  and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .

en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .

en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not ; and it shall be given him .
as: কিন্তু আপোনালোকৰ কাৰোবাৰ যদি জ্ঞান   ৰ অভাৱ হয় তেনেহলে যি জন দিওঁতা ঈশ্বৰ , যি জনে গৰিহণা নকৰাকৈ মুক্তহস্তে সকলোকে দান কৰে , তেওঁক যাচনা কৰক    আৰু তাতে আপোনালোকক দিয়া হ’ব ।
